messages:
mira: Quick design idea: add a 'Guided quickstart' banner on first-run that suggests 2 sample projects tailored by inferred role (e.g., "Product" vs "Platform") instead of a long list. Option 1: inference-based suggestions + small rationale; Option 2: universal curated picks. Which do we like for MVP?

dan: I'm cautious about inference for MVP. Wrong suggestions could confuse. If we do inference, make it obviously overrideable with a 'Show all samples' link.

soph: Research insight: users liked personalization when it was accurate and explainable. Key: show a one-line reason under each sample: "Suggested because you viewed the Console docs". That builds trust.

leo: Accessibility nits: if we provide an explanation, it must be exposed to screen readers (aria-describedby) and not just visual. Also any inferred label should be editable by the user (e.g., 'Role: Product' with edit control).

mira: Agree — show rationale + small edit control. Microcopy idea for rationale: "Suggested based on your activity in the console" vs too-technical "based on telemetry". Keep privacy-first.

aria: Copy tweak: primary CTA on banner currently "Get started with a sample" (long). For the tailored banner try shorter: "Try these" and per-card CTA "Open demo". Also add a tiny secondary "Why this?" link that opens a tooltip with the rationale.

qa-bot: quick check: telemetry scope - if we show 'why this' text we must not include raw event payloads in the UI. Only human-readable reasons.

dan: Implementation question: how do we surface fallback if inference fails? propose fallback to curated top 2. And add a small control 'Show different suggestions' to re-roll.

soph: For localization: keep CTA short to avoid truncation. Also ensure screenshots have localized alt text; we'll need translations for rationale tooltip too.

leo: Contrast: the role pill color + white text at 11px fails AA. Use 13px semibold or darker background. Also make the 'Why this?' link keyboard-focusable with visible outline.

mira: Ok consensus: allow inference but opt-outable, show rationale, provide clear override, and fall back to curated. Action items: 1) Dan - backend flag for inference + fallback logic 2) Soph - write rationale copy variants + localization strings 3) Leo - a11y review (aria-describedby, contrast, focus) 4) Aria - update comps with "Why this?" tooltip and edit-role control.

aria: I'll mock minimal mobile layout: banner collapses to one compact card with 'Show more' that expands to two. CTA becomes "Try" on narrow widths.

dan: Also add telemetry events: onboarding.banner.viewed, onboarding.sample.suggested (with reasonCode only), onboarding.sample.opened. Avoid sending inferred role value in analytics to limit exposure.

qa-bot: test matrix: include keyboard-only, screen reader, and high-contrast mode checks. I'll add tests for 'Why this?' tooltip visibility to the onboarding test suite.

mira: Thanks team. Let's A/B test inference vs curated for 2 weeks. I'll add a ticket to the onboarding epic and assign owners. Will post updated comps tomorrow. :sparkles:
